channel.description: Latest articles from Nation of Change (nationofchange.org)

item.title: Why gutting this agency amounts to playing with fire
item.description: “If it weren’t for NIOSH, we wouldn’t have the reliable and safe gear we do today. We’d be smoke eaters.”

item.title: Netanyahu presses Trump for renewed Iran war push amid widening regional disputes
item.description: As Israel’s prime minister heads to Mar-a-Lago, reports indicate he will seek U.S. backing for new military action against Iran while clashing with Washington over Gaza, Syria, and Lebanon.

item.title: What defective “moral majority” thinks rewarding might-makes-right immoralists won’t make America immoral?
item.description: When unchecked power rules, wallowing in its abuse of “Radical Left Scum,” then unchecked immorality follows.

item.title: Trump slashes U.S. humanitarian aid as global death toll mounts
item.description: A $2 billion pledge to the United Nations masks a historic collapse in U.S. humanitarian funding following the dismantling of USAID, as experts estimate more than 700,000 deaths linked to foreign aid cuts.
